body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/preflight/test/integration.test.mjs` and `packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs` manually manage temporary test directories via local `makeTmp` / `cleanTmp` helpers and 12 `after(() => cleanTmp(dir))` hooks, and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`, `gitRepo`), test suites and test cases bind temporary directories and git repositories to the test context `t`, automatically cleaning them up via `t.after`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/preflight/test/integration.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp, gitRepo }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - In `before((t) => ...)` hooks or individual tests, allocate temporary directories using `tmp(t, 'preflight-int-')` or `gitRepo(t, { prefix: 'preflight-int-' })`.
   - Remove local `function makeTmp()` and `function cleanTmp(dir)` helpers.
   - Remove all manual `after(() => cleanTmp(dir))` hooks and direct `cleanTmp(...)` calls.
2. In `packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp, gitRepo }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - In `before((t) => ...)` hooks or individual tests, allocate temporary directories using `tmp(t, 'preflight-unit-')`.
   - Remove local `function makeTmp()` and `function cleanTmp(dir)` helpers.
   - Remove all manual `after(() => cleanTmp(dir))` hooks, direct `cleanTmp(...)` calls, and `try/finally` blocks.
3. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/preflight/test/integration.test.mjs'` and `'packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set.
4. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/preflight` exits 0 with all 43 tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'cleanTmp' packages/preflight/test/integration.test.mjs packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs` outputs 0, 0.
   - `grep -c 'makeTmp' packages/preflight/test/integration.test.mjs packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs` outputs 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'cleanTmp' packages/preflight/test/integration.test.mjs packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs` reports 0, 0.
- AC2 `grep -c 'makeTmp' packages/preflight/test/integration.test.mjs packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs` reports 0, 0.
- AC3 `grep -E 'packages/preflight/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/preflight` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(preflight): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate after-cleanup blocks in integration and unit tests
